description: This Java class 'DefaultStreamingConfig' implements the 'StreamingConfig' interface and provides configuration settings for streaming, including session interval, parallelism, acknowledgment, websocket, SSE, and signal enrichment configurations. It includes methods for instantiation from a config object, getters for each setting, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultStreamingConfig
